findings.issue: The @returns text says the method returns a new object with the default namespace set whenever the entity has no truthy namespace. That is false for `namespace: ''` and `namespace: null`: the guard falls through to lodash.merge, whose source value overwrites the default. Run against lodash: both inputs return a new object that keeps the empty or null value, and only undefined gets the default. The summary on line 35 has the same gap. The text matches the plan word for word, so this is a defect in the U11 site rule, not in the typing. Confidence: high on behavior, and it is an edge case because the type only allows string or undefined.
findings.fix: Reword @returns to say that a new object gets the default namespace only when `metadata.namespace` is undefined, and that an empty or null namespace is kept in the new object. This needs a matching change to the U11 site text, which the plan requires word for word.

findings.issue: The @throws text covers only errors that name a field, but `entity.metadata.name` is read before `require` runs, so an entity with no `metadata` rejects with a plain TypeError that matches none of the listed cases. U12's behaviour line asks for when the method rejects, and the sibling blocks U11 and U13 document this same TypeError case, so the set is inconsistent. The text matches the plan word for word, so this is a gap in the U12 site rule.
findings.fix: Extend @throws with the TypeError for an entity that has no `metadata`, in the wording U11 uses. This needs a matching change to the U12 site text.
